claims.text: App-delivered sleep programs commonly reproduce selected components of therapist-guided CBT-I but may offer less individualized feedback.
Digital sleep therapy appears to retain partial efficacy compared with therapist-guided protocols, although reported effects vary across studies.
CBT-I trial evidence shows improved sleep onset latency with benefits persisting at six-month follow-up.
Durability and adherence are key uncertainties for digital sleep interventions, particularly when schedules are irregular or follow-up is brief.
